newsitem.title: USA: U.S. lifts order to dependents to leave Tajikistan.
newsitem.headline: U.S. lifts order to dependents to leave Tajikistan.

text.p: Citing improved security in the Tajikistan capital Dushanbe, the U.S. State Department said on Wednesday it had rescinded a Feb. 20 order requiring embassy dependents to leave the Central Asian country.

"There has been significant improvement in the security situation there in Dushanbe, adequate to permit return to Tajikistan of family members of American employees," department spokesman Nicholas Burns said.

Although the Tajik government and Islamic opposition agreed a ceasefire last December after four years of civil war, dependents were pulled out after a series of killings, including of two U.S. embassy guards who were ethnic Russians, in Dushanbe.
Burns said the State Department was also lifting a recommendation to American citizens to defer travel to Dushanbe.
